0: Opening pose: the carrier comes nearly bow on (3 degrees); the doodle's long slab is seen from just off its bow, the deck foreshortened, the long edges receding up the frame, the hull strokes meeting in the V of the bow under the deck.
6: Same heading while the camera pans; the slab slides right with the deck's front edge.
12: Still bow on; the slab rides a little lower as the ship approaches.
18: The ship approaches; the slab grows slightly, heading unchanged.
24: Last frames of the straight approach before the swing starts at 26.
27: The swing begins: from here the slab rotates by the same small step every frame until 49.
30: Even swing: the near long edge leans further over and the near side of the hull starts to show.
33: Even swing: the near side of the hull widens under the deck edge.
36: Even swing: the deck now runs from the island down toward the bow corner.
39: Even swing: the stem moves right under the bow face.
42: Even swing: the deck diagonal flattens toward three-quarter.
45: The line: the deck reads as a long diagonal from the island to the bow, with the hull side and the stem below it.
47: Swing continues; the bow face narrows.
48: Swing continues; the ship grows as it closes on the camera.
49: Last frame: three-quarter view, deck diagonal from upper left to the bow, stem at lower right.
